_comment_READ_ME_FIRST: Copy the object below into site/_data/locations.json, as one more entry in the list between the square brackets. Don't invent which stories or residents belong to a location if you're not sure — leave those lists empty or short rather than guessing.
name: Location Name
shortDescription: One or two sentences describing this place.
_comment_images: a list of image ids from site/_data/images.json that show this place
_comment_associatedResidents: a list of resident ids (from site/_data/residents.json) who are usually found here
_comment_relatedStorySeries: a list of seriesId values (like royal-summer) for story series set at this location
